name: Gaia DR3 over SDN
description: Gaia DR3 with Bailer-Jones et al. 2021 distances (Hipparcos 2007 for the brightest and Gaia-missing stars) as two SDN layers on a provider node: the angular layer ($SKT HEALPix order-4 tiles of $STR rows, SKT.fbs gaia-dr3/angular-g13.5) and a magnitude-sorted heliocentric octree after Sagrista et al. 2019 ($SKT OCTREE_HELIO_ICRS nodes, SKT.fbs gaia-dr3/octree-g13.5), tile payloads in the node's IPFS. Fetched from ESA's Gaia archive (TAP) by http.request. Its consumer side is the companion module com.digitalarsenal.data-source.gaia-octree-cones (cones/). Configuration by plugin.getConfig: gaia_octree_enabled, gaia_octree_producer_peer_id, gaia_octree_g_limit, gaia_octree_tap_url, gaia_octree_sky, gaia_octree_range_rows.

sequentialJustification.detail: Host calls in turn (TAP queries, ipfs.add per tile, one ingest per layer); the octree sort and the extinction table are single-threaded passes over the stars held in linear memory. milky-way-model's pthreads bake is not linked; only its dust field headers are.

methods.displayName: Retrieve Gaia DR3 and file both layers

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice Info, REASON cycle, ITEMS [the producer peer ID]: the cycle retrieve_gaia runs.

Two FlowNotices Info, REASON filed: SOURCE_NAME angular-g13.5 (COUNT tiles filed; ITEMS tiles, stars, gaia, hipparcos_only, bright_edsd, range_splits, strays, patched_tiles, outside_sky, tap_queries, tap_bytes, seconds) and octree-g13.5 (COUNT nodes filed; ITEMS nodes, stars, depth, max_float32_error_per_edge, seconds).

outputPorts.description: What was filed: each layer's tiles or nodes and stars, the strays and patches, the octree depth and its float32 error, the TAP queries and bytes; flow bookkeeping, never a data record.
